reason: Both conversations asked sensible questions (which zone, display behaviour, glow) and correctly escalated to an engineer rather than suggesting DIY work under the glass. Conversation 2 gave the more honest diagnosis, naming the radiant element as most likely but explicitly keeping the zone's board output circuit in play and stating the engineer must test before anything is bought, which matches the genuinely uncertain hidden truth. Conversation 2's only real gap is not requesting the full model number, which is minor since parts were not yet justified.
